en: The *Buddhabhāṣita-maitreyabodhisattvapraṇidhānadhāraṇīsūtra*,
translated by the Tripitaka Master of the Western Heaven, the Court Dispersing Grandee, Acting Director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments,
Great Master of Illuminating Teaching, Subject Faxian, by Imperial Decree.
At that time, the Buddha addressed Maitreya Bodhisattva, saying:
"You should listen attentively. There is a dhāraṇī possessed of great majestic power and supreme merit, which can cause sentient beings to be liberated from the evil realms."
Upon turning back, one shall obtain supreme and wondrous bliss.
Then, the Bodhisattva Maitreya addressed the World-Honored One, saying, "I pray that you will proclaim it for us.
Thereupon, the World-Honored One spoke this dhāraṇī:
Namo bhagavate śākyamunaye tathāgatāya arhate samyaksaṃbuddhāya | Tadyathā | Ajite ajitañjaye ||
Hrayaṃ (1) saptavara vara (2) maitrāvalokite (3) kara kara (4) mahāsamayasiddhe (5) vara vara (6) ṭiṭṭimaṇḍalavati (7) samara samara (8) svāhā. (9)10.
Catur-asamaṃ ghaṭa-samaya (15) ṛdhi ṛdhi (16) mahā-ṛdhi svāhā (17). At that time, the Bodhisattva Maitreya...
Having heard the World-Honored Buddha speak this dhāraṇī,
he addressed him, saying: "World-Honored One,
this dhāraṇī possesses great benefit."
He is able to cause sentient beings to attain liberation from the evil realms.
At that time, Maitreya Bodhisattva again made this vow:
"If there are sentient beings in the future age, during the period of the Final Dharma..."
If there are those who can read, recite, receive,
and uphold [this], even if they should fall into the Avīci Hell due to past karma,
when I attain Buddhahood, I shall use my Buddha-power to rescue and deliver them.
Furthermore, he was granted the prediction of *anuttara-samyak-saṃbodhi*.
When the Bodhisattva Maitreya had finished speaking these words,
he prostrated at the Buddha’s feet and withdrew with joy.
The Sutra on the Dhāraṇī of the Bodhisattva Maitreya’s Vow Spoken by the Buddha.
